CompositeOT.model¶

Problem representation for the CompositeOT solver.

This module intentionally separates two concepts:

  • Model will be the mutable, user-facing builder, similar in spirit to Gurobi or Mosek modeling objects.

  • CompositeOTProblem is the immutable compiled representation consumed by the numerical solver.

The compiled problem mirrors the paper’s template:

min <C, X> + R(X) + h(D) + p_r(y) + p_c(z)
s.t. A X B + D = S,
     X 1 + y = alpha,
     X.T 1 + z = beta.

For now this object is NumPy-first and component-agnostic. By default it specializes to the classic OT model:

min <C, X>
s.t. X >= 0,
     X 1 = alpha,
     X.T 1 = beta.

The side relation is stored explicitly as A X B + D = S to match the paper directly when side constraints are supplied.

Notation used throughout the package:

X

Transport plan with shape (m, n).

D

Slack for the side relation A X B + D = S. It has shape S.shape; with no side relation it is the empty (0, 0) array.

y and z

Row and column marginal slacks.

W, u, and v

Dual variables for the side, row, and column equations.
